## User Stories

### Create formatDuration utility function
- **Story:** As a developer, I want a pure function to convert milliseconds to formatted strings so that I can consistently display durations across the application
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Function accepts milliseconds as input
  - [ ] Returns string with appropriate unit (ms or s)
  - [ ] Handles zero duration
  - [ ] Handles durations > 1000ms by converting to seconds
  - [ ] Includes unit label in output string
  - [ ] Has proper TypeScript types

### Implement DurationFormatter component
- **Story:** As a developer, I want a reusable duration formatter component so that I can display formatted durations in any part of the UI
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Component accepts duration in milliseconds as prop
  - [ ] Renders formatted duration using formatDuration utility
  - [ ] Updates when duration prop changes
  - [ ] Has configurable styling options
  - [ ] Includes documentation and usage examples

### Add duration formatter unit tests
- **Story:** As a developer, I want comprehensive unit tests for duration formatting so that I can ensure reliable functionality across edge cases
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Test zero duration case
  - [ ] Test millisecond formatting (<1s)
  - [ ] Test second formatting (>=1s)
  - [ ] Test very large durations
  - [ ] Test invalid inputs
  - [ ] Achieve >90% test coverage


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
